Calculate age- or duration-specific group-transition rates

Source: R/calculate_transition_rates.R
calculate_transition_rates.Rd

Count individual moves and person-years in their origin group in half-open Lexis cells. Each outgoing destination shares its origin's exposure: do not sum denominators across destinations. Duration is years since the latest group entry, or age before the first recorded transition; return moves reset duration and union changes do not. Events use the exiting group's duration. Death and competing moves end exposure. Rates are cause-specific hazards, not transition probabilities. Internal-boundary events enter the cell starting there; the final calendar boundary is excluded.

Usage

calculate_transition_rates(
  population,
  time_breaks,
  age_breaks = NULL,
  dur_breaks = NULL,
  by_sex = FALSE,
  by_union_type = FALSE,
  conf.level = NULL
)

Arguments

population

A grouped hammel_population with a known endpoint and complete person, transition and (when requested) union histories.

time_breaks

Strictly increasing finite calendar boundaries in years.

age_breaks

Optional strictly increasing nonnegative age boundaries.

dur_breaks

Optional strictly increasing nonnegative group-duration boundaries. Supply exactly one of age_breaks and dur_breaks. A finite final axis boundary gains Inf.

by_sex

Logical, default FALSE. Disaggregate by sex (m/f).

by_union_type

Logical, default FALSE. Disaggregate exposure and events by current union type. Typed histories use unpartnered/cohab/marriage; untyped histories use unpartnered/partnered. Requires exclusive histories.

conf.level

NULL (default) to omit confidence intervals, or a finite numeric scalar strictly between 0 and 1. Adds conf_low and conf_high from two-sided exact stats::poisson.test() intervals for observed event counts over exposure. Bounds are NA at zero exposure. For fertility, these describe the observed rate, not the unrealized-adjusted rate.

Value

A tibble with time_start, time_end, age or duration bounds, group_origin, group_dest, optional sex and union_type, person_years, transitions, and rate_transition (NA at zero exposure). All distinct directed pairs among current and historical identities are retained, including zero-event cells. Fewer than two known groups returns a typed empty tibble. Period varies fastest within axis bands and pair blocks. With non-NULL conf.level, also includes conf_low and conf_high.

Examples

persons <- data.frame(person_id = 1, sex = "f", birth_time = 0,
  death_time = NA_real_, mother_id = NA_real_, father_id = NA_real_, group = "B")
population <- hammel_population(persons, end_time = 5,
  transitions = data.frame(person_id = 1, time = 2,
    group_origin = "A", group_dest = "B"))
calculate_transition_rates(population, c(0, 5), age_breaks = c(0, Inf))
#> # A tibble: 2 × 9
#>   time_start time_end age_start age_end group_origin group_dest person_years
#>        <dbl>    <dbl>     <dbl>   <dbl> <chr>        <chr>             <dbl>
#> 1          0        5         0     Inf B            A                     3
#> 2          0        5         0     Inf A            B                     2
#> # ℹ 2 more variables: transitions <dbl>, rate_transition <dbl>
